name: codex-dsh-connect
description: Delegate scoped project file tasks to native DeepSeek Harness with explicit workspace isolation.

interface.longDescription: Run native DeepSeek Harness against an explicitly authorized project using macOS Seatbelt or Linux bubblewrap. Windows execution requires WSL2. Requires a supported local Node runtime, the pinned Harness installation and native account login. Linux live Harness and real WSL2 validation remain pending.
defaultPrompt: Set up Codex DSH Connect for one project I choose.
Use DeepSeek Harness to investigate the files I specify and return a concise report.
